basic.name: Void Prison
basic.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

basic.name: Devouring Maw
basic.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94~~0.04~~ damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

basic.name: Cocoon
basic.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

heroic.name: Gorge
heroic.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274~~0.04~~ damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

trait.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
trait.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171~~0.04~~ damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

mount.name: Horrify
mount.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

activable.name: Taunt
activable.description:
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.

Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.
